spaces.name: Sunroom

Display geometry was redrawn from the direct 5.02m Hallway/Sunroom-to-NW-window and 4.07m Lounge/Sunroom-to-west-window checks while preserving the accepted lounge slider position. The 5.02m sunroom span is retained as a measured check but is not treated as a vertical projection, so the NW/top sunroom edge stays roughly level with and just below the lounge external wall.

spaces.name: Lounge
spaces.notes: Included only to anchor the photo-verified sunroom-to-lounge slider relationship. The sunroom-side wall is shifted right so the clear lounge width reads as the measured 3.70m while the kitchen/dining divider stays fixed. The north external wall is pushed outward so the lounge clear depth reads as the measured 4.90m.

spaces.name: Kitchen / Dining
spaces.notes: Promoted after deck-side photos verified the large door group and adjacent glazing. Lower-left vinyl flooring now continues down to the hallway/entrance line to avoid the old notch in the rendered floor surface, while the left boundary below the dining external wall is pulled back to the kitchen/lounge divider line so hard flooring does not creep into the lounge or hallway. The north dining external wall is pushed outward so the clear span from the Bedroom 2 entrance to the dining end wall reads as the remeasured 8.12m.

spaces.name: Entrance
spaces.notes: Photo-verified glazed deck-side entrance/back-entry space connected to laundry. Display geometry now follows the updated measured chain: 2.52m from the entrance/laundry opening line back to the narrowing point, then 1.13m left to the inside of the kitchen door frame before the entrance widens by 0.25m. The return wall remains recorded at 130mm thick.

spaces.name: Laundry
spaces.notes: Photo-verified laundry beyond entrance with washing machines, sink/bench, and exterior window. Display top edge is aligned to the deck-side entrance internal line. The Bedroom 2/laundry wall is shifted left so the laundry/toilet clear internal width is 1.80m, with the lower divider reset from the remeasured stack so the laundry clear height is about 3.03m.

spaces.name: Toilet
spaces.notes: Photo-verified small toilet room connected from laundry with frosted exterior window. The Bedroom 2/laundry wall is shifted left so the laundry/toilet clear internal width is 1.80m. The bottom exterior wall strip is remeasured as 270mm, and the laundry/toilet divider preserves the remeasured 0.91m toilet clear depth.

spaces.name: Hallway
spaces.notes: Photo-verified interior circulation spine connecting lounge/office side toward entrance and laundry, with bathroom sliding door visible on the side wall. Display floor footprint stops at the kitchen wall line so carpet does not overlay the vinyl flooring continuation at the entrance/kitchen corner.

spaces.name: Master Bedroom

The 0.62m-deep built-in wardrobe is a separate bay between the master bedroom and office rather than space taken from the master floor area. office.notes: SE window gives likely morning light with reduced afternoon exposure.

bathroom.notes: SE external window; small wet-area window and neighbour-side shading likely limit daylight.

bedroom_2.notes: SE window faces neighbour fence, so morning light is plausible but shading risk is high.

entrance.notes: Glazed deck-side entrance receives daylight but may be shaded by roof/eaves and adjacent walls.

laundry.notes: NE and NW windows should provide better daylight than most service areas, but garage/deck shading needs checking.

toilet.notes: Small service room with limited glazing.
